title: Why Marcus Fenix was in prison in Gears of War
subject: marcus
description:
Would you have abandoned your post too? 👇

Why Marcus Fenix was in prison at the start of Gears of War, and the truth about his father. Spoilers for the Gears of War trilogy.

scenes.text: Marcus Fenix threw away his freedom for a father who wasn't dead.
During a desperate battle, he abandoned his post to rescue Adam Fenix. He arrived too late. The house had collapsed.
For deserting, the war hero got forty years in prison. He served four, until Dom broke him out.
But that's not the worst part. Adam had survived.
He was secretly taken to Azura, a hidden island base, and kept there while his son sat in a cell.
